newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias up 27 pct on auction reports.
newsitem.headline: Victorias up 27 pct on auction reports.

text.p: Cash-strapped Victorias Milling Co Inc rose 60 centavos, or 27.3 percent, to 2.8 pesos in late trading on Wednesday helped by reports that the sugar miller would soon be auctioned, brokers said.
"They are selling Victorias and that's positive news," said Allan Araullo, vice-president at Regina Capital Development Corp.
Victorias officials, however, were not immediately available for comment.

Newspaper reports on Wednesday quoted PCI Bank president Rafael Buenaventura as saying that the sale may take place soon. PCI Bank heads the advisory group of the committee created by the sugar miller's 32 creditor banks.
"They are bidding out Victorias and there's talk that some big food companies may be interested," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
